keyGuarantees: exactly one anchored event with lasting effects, within a generation
pools.ruling: Colour, not scoped: speaks of the past, asserts no present calm.

lines.text: The {calamity} is recent enough that {settlement} still divides time by it, and the record still marks it as bearing on the town today.
What the {calamity} took from {settlement} is still being counted, and some of the counting is done aloud.
{settlement} has the particular carefulness of a town that was lately reminded what can happen to towns.

keyGuarantees: exactly one anchored event with lasting effects, older_than_bearers
pools.ruling: Colour, not scoped: speaks of the past, asserts no present calm.

lines.text: The {calamity} is {timeband_age} now, and {settlement} keeps it the way old towns keep such things, in habits whose reasons have outlived the people who could explain them.
The record of the {calamity} survives in what {settlement} does differently since; the event is old and its instructions are still being followed.
Nobody now in {settlement} saw the {calamity}, and everybody here lives in the town it made.

keyGuarantees: more than one anchored event with lasting effects
pools.ruling: Colour, not scoped: speaks of the past, asserts no present calm.

lines.text: {settlement}'s record is a stack of hard seasons survived in order, and the record still marks each of them as bearing on the town.
{settlement} has been knocked down and has answered more than once, and the answering shows; this is a town with practice.

keyGuarantees: an unanchored (anchored === false) event with lasting effects, none anchored
pools.ruling: Colour, not scoped: speaks of the past, asserts no present calm.

lines.text: The {calamity} stands on {settlement}'s record and the record does not carry it forward; it happened here, and what it left is no longer counted among the things that explain the place.
{settlement} keeps the {calamity} as an event rather than as a cause, which is what a town does with the troubles it has finished having.

keyGuarantees: no anchored or unanchored event with lasting effects and no major/catastrophic event
pools.ruling: Scoped: line 1 says the town's history is the quiet, even kind, which an active crisis contradicts; line 2 speaks only of the books.

lines.text: No great blow stands on {settlement}'s record; the town's history is the quieter kind, and its evenness is the inheritance.
{settlement}'s books record no disaster worth the word, which is itself a fact about the place worth recording.
